# RTSP ingest source provenance

This source-only package retains 29 audited module trees. `manifest.json` lists every retained source file and SHA-256, upstream metadata, two synthetic proxy module files and the two incomplete historical h1 exceptions, and binary fixtures and archives omitted from this package. Local changes and omitted binary fixtures mean the retained trees are not authenticated by the upstream h1 values. The patches are applied in manifest order; gortsplib's SEI correction follows its validated patch. The upstream module files remain unchanged, except for the two identified synthetic proxy go.mod files that upstream archives lacked. The retained gortsplib go.sum also mirrors the helper checksum additions, as disclosed in manifest.json.

`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` retains the 44 selected-graph source notices, including graph-only and test material. Individual source headers and legal files remain in the trees. Original project contributions use the repository MIT license. `module-graph.json` records all 76 require declarations from the 29 retained go.mod files. Its edges are declared minimum requirements, including graph-only and test dependencies. The selected versions are proposed retained selections; no observed Go graph is recorded. Five declared module paths have no retained tree: github.com/orcaman/writerseeker, github.com/sunfish-shogi/bufseekio, golang.org/x/sync, gopkg.in/check.v1 and gopkg.in/src-d/go-billy.v4. The coverage metadata lists each declaration and its source line. Static traversal stops at the retained module files; external module metadata, package import traversal, lazy pruning and offline closure remain unresolved until admitted Linux Go qualification. No missing dependency is presumed pruned. Future binary distributions require a separate review of the actual linked closure, Go standard library and vendor licenses and patents.

Run `python3 third_party/rtsp-ingest/verify.py` for a source-only integrity check. It does not compile, execute Go, verify an upstream h1, or establish runtime acceptance.

The repository Renovate configuration disables dependency updates for this path, because every retained byte is pinned by `manifest.json`. An upstream version bump needs a manual provenance re-audit and a manifest update before any vendored file changes.

Binary fixture omissions can prevent upstream tests from running. The x/net public suffix tables remain as embedded data required by source, not executable binaries.
